entradas.text: It was the morning of Livia's trial, and hordes of reporters were gathered in front of the state courthouse. Petr, Lucian and I stood by the entrance.

Lucian had helped break the news of my secretary's arrest. Now the media was beginning to question exactly how a Rumburg agent had been able to infiltrate the Maroon Palace. It was time for me to deliver an explanation.
A podium with a bank of microphones awaited us on the courthouse steps. Petr looked uncertain. I had told him I would be doing all the talking today.
"Remember what we talked about, Mr. President."
"Koronti's reporters will ask softball questions. But I'd still advise you to keep your responses as brief as possible."
"You're on your own, Mr. President. I'd advise you to keep your responses as brief as possible."
How could I forget? I was about to blame my best friend for a scandal that would otherwise shatter my administration. And Petr still had no idea.
Together, we stepped behind the podium. The reporters clustered around us and started shouting questions.
"Thank you for coming."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for coming."

entradas.text: I nodded. Petr took a deep breath.
"Please settle down."
entradas.menu: "Please settle down."

entradas.text: "As you are aware, Livia Suno, former secretary to the President of Sordland, is currently being tried for espionage."
entradas.menu: "As you are aware, Livia Suno, former secretary to the President of Sordland, is currently being tried for espionage."

entradas.text: "As you are aware, Ilana Vance, the Rumburg spy who posed as my secretary, is currently on trial for espionage."
entradas.menu: "As you are aware, Ilana Vance, the Rumburg spy who posed as my secretary, is currently on trial for espionage."

entradas.text: "It is unknown exactly how this woman managed to infiltrate our administration."
entradas.menu: "It is unknown exactly how this woman managed to infiltrate our administration."

entradas.text: "Using advanced document forging technology, this woman managed to pass our rigorous background checks and infiltrate our administration."
entradas.menu: "Using advanced document forging technology, this woman managed to pass our rigorous background checks and infiltrate our administration."

entradas.text: "Certain officials failed to conduct the necessary background checks that would have prevented this woman from infiltrating our administration. They are now under investigation."
entradas.menu: "Certain officials failed to conduct the necessary background checks that would have prevented her from infiltrating our administration. They are now under investigation."

entradas.text: "Please rest assured that the traitor will be brought to justice."
entradas.menu: "Please rest assured that the traitor will be brought to justice."

entradas.text: "Any further covert operations on Rumburg's part shall be met with our full retaliation."
entradas.menu: "Any further covert operations on Rumburg's part shall be met with our full retaliation."

entradas.text: “We remain vigilant against external and internal enemies. We will not tolerate any crimes against the state.”
entradas.menu: “We remain vigilant against external and internal enemies. We will not tolerate any crimes against the state.”

entradas.text: “Despite the efforts to undermine the administration, we are strong, unified and capable as ever.”
entradas.menu: “Despite the efforts to undermine the administration, we are strong, unified and capable as ever.”

entradas.text: "Both Mr. Vectern and I remain committed to keeping the great country of Sordland safe and secure."
entradas.menu: "Both Mr. Vectern and I remain committed to keeping the great country of Sordland safe and secure."

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: Many camera flashes went off. A reporter raised her hand to speak.
"Yes? What is it?"
entradas.menu: "Yes? What is it?"

entradas.text: I gestured to the reporter.
entradas.menu: Let the reporter ask a question.

entradas.text: "Mr. Vectern, I have credible sources saying you personally oversaw Miss Suno's hiring and may have even been carrying on an inappropriate relationship with her--"
"Mr. President, have you chosen your next secretary yet?"
entradas.menu: "Mr. President, have you chosen your next secretary yet? Whoever she is, she's one lucky girl."

entradas.text: I put a hand over Petr's mic.
"Attempts by our enemies to smear Mr. Vectern's reputation and further divide the administration. Nothing more."
entradas.menu: "Attempts by our enemies to smear Mr. Vectern's reputation and further divide the administration. Nothing more."

entradas.text: "Whoever these 'sources' are, they're lying. Mr. Vectern's conduct has been nothing but honorable."
entradas.menu: "Whoever these 'sources' are, they're lying. Mr. Vectern's conduct has been nothing but honorable."

entradas.text: "Would you like to submit an application?"
entradas.menu: "Would you like to submit an application?"

entradas.text: "Not yet. But we'll make sure she's blonde this time."
entradas.menu: "Not yet. But we'll make sure she's blonde this time."

entradas.text: "I have a few candidates in mind."
entradas.menu: "I have a few candidates in mind."

entradas.text: The crowd of reporters all laughed. I sent a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.
The crowd of reporters nodded seriously. I sent a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.
"Well, whoever she is, she's one lucky girl."
"My source comes from within the Maroon Palace itself."
"And are you going to disregard Mr. Vectern's established reputation as a serial philanderer?"
"Men will be men."
entradas.menu: "Men will be men."

entradas.text: "Lies. All lies."
entradas.menu: "Lies. All lies."

entradas.text: I silently gestured to Lucian to end the press conference.
entradas.menu: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

entradas.text: Lucian interjected.
“The President will not be taking any more questions. Thank you.”
He, Petr and I began walking back to the courthouse. Petr and I hung behind to talk.
"Evelyn's still divorcing me, that can't be helped. But overall, this was nowhere near as bad as it could've been."
"A source within the palace? Who do you think she meant?"
entradas.menu: "A source within the palace? Who do you think she meant?"

entradas.text: "You should be thanking your lucky stars you're not in that courthouse with her."
entradas.menu: "You should be thanking your lucky stars you're not in that courthouse with her."

entradas.text: "We have Marcel to thank for that."
entradas.menu: "We have Marcel to thank for that."

entradas.text: "Sorry about Evelyn."
entradas.menu: "Sorry about Evelyn."

entradas.text: "I know, I know."
"She was right. I don't deserve her."
entradas.menu: "She was right. I don't deserve her."

entradas.text: "Eh, I'd wager anything she made that up."
"At least everything can go back to normal now."
I stared at the back of Lucian's head as he disappeared inside the courthouse.
Normal. We would see about that.
"That she did can be directly traced to the carelessness of one man: Petr Vectern."
entradas.menu: "That she did can be directly traced to the carelessness of one man: Petr Vectern."

entradas.text: "Therefore, the vice president shall be trialled for his shameful actions against the state. If found guilty, he will be imprisoned. Take him."
entradas.menu: "Therefore, the vice president shall be trialled for his shameful actions against the state. If found guilty, he will be imprisoned. Take him."

entradas.text: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."

entradas.text: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."

entradas.text: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."

entradas.text: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."
entradas.menu: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."

entradas.text: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."
entradas.menu: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."

entradas.text: "She did so by exploiting the weakness of Vice President Petr Vectern."
entradas.menu: "She did so by exploiting the weakness of Vice President Petr Vectern."

entradas.text: The journalists gasped and murmured. Petr turned to face me, his mouth hanging open.
"Mr. Vectern's willingness to put his own infantile desires over Sordland's security has made him a threat to the state."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Vectern's willingness to put his own infantile desires over Sordland's security has made him a threat to the state."

entradas.text: "Mr. Vectern's recklessness, to say nothing of his betrayal of Sordish values, has disgraced my administration."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Vectern's recklessness, to say nothing of his betrayal of Sordish values, has disgraced my administration."

entradas.text: "Therefore, the vice president has tendered his resignation. Effective immediately."
entradas.menu: "Therefore, the vice president has tendered his resignation. Effective immediately."

entradas.text: "Wait just a--"
I put my hand over his mic and gestured to Karl Greiser, who was waiting offstage. He and his men approached Petr.
"How could you do this to me? I know I screwed up, but, Anton -- prison?"
"Save it for the witness stand."
entradas.menu: "Save it for the witness stand."

entradas.text: "Sorry. Lucian made me."
entradas.menu: "Sorry. Lucian made me."

entradas.text: "Stop acting like this whole chain of events wasn't your fault."
entradas.menu: "Stop acting like this whole chain of events wasn't your fault."

entradas.text: "This is for the good of Sordland. Trust me."
entradas.menu: "This is for the good of Sordland. Trust me."

entradas.text: Karl and his men grabbed Petr's arms.
"Fuck you, Anton! You hear me? Fu--"
The clamor of reporters drowned out his screams as he was led away.
"Mr. President!"
The clamor of reporters was growing louder. Petr grabbed me by the collar and yanked me away from the microphones.
"Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."

entradas.text: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."

entradas.menu: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."

entradas.menu: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."

entradas.text: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."
entradas.menu: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."

entradas.text: "That she was able to do so is solely due to carelessness on the part of myself and Vice President Petr Vectern."
entradas.menu: "That she was able to do so is solely due to carelessness on the part of myself and Vice President Petr Vectern."

entradas.text: "I and Vice President Petr Vectern would like to take this opportunity to apologize for our disgraceful lack of oversight."
entradas.menu: "I and Vice President Petr Vectern would like to take this opportunity to apologize for our disgraceful lack of oversight."

entradas.text: The journalists gasps and murmured. Petr turned to face me, his mouth hanging open.
"In his impulsive hiring practices, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."
entradas.menu: "In his impulsive hiring practices, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."

entradas.text: "In falling victim to seduction, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."
entradas.menu: "In falling victim to seduction, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."

entradas.text: "I have failed in my duty to keep this country safe and secure. I hope I can regain your trust."
entradas.menu: "I have failed in my duty to keep this country safe and secure. I hope I can regain your trust."

entradas.text: "I failed to notice the enemy that was right under my nose. I hope I can regain your trust."
entradas.menu: "I failed to notice the enemy that was right under my nose. I hope I can regain your trust."

entradas.text: "No! This isn't right!"
Sweat was beading on Petr's brow. He grabbed the closest microphone.
"Please, don't listen to President Rayne. This is all my fault."
"I was drunk and reckless. I broke my marriage vows. My selfishness compromised the Rayne administration and all of Sordland."
Tears began streaming down his face.
"I've been a sorry excuse for a husband and a terrible vice president. I resign."
"You don't have to do this."
entradas.menu: "You don't have to do this."

entradas.text: "Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Thank you."

entradas.text: The crowd became even louder. I turned away from the microphones and looked at Petr.
"Yes, I do. You'd never survive the term otherwise. Even with Marcel doing his best."
"Yes, I do. You'd never survive the term otherwise."
"And I owe you this much, after what I did."
"I owe you this much, after what I did."
The reporters were now waving for us. One woman in the front row looked particularly insistent.
"Mr. Vectern!"
I nodded at Petr to take her question.
entradas.menu: Let Petr take the question.

entradas.text: "I will be answering all questions on the vice president's behalf."
entradas.menu: "I will be answering all questions on the vice president's behalf."

entradas.text: "Are you implying that you and the covert agent posing as President Rayne's secretary were engaged in intimate relations?"
"Yes. And it wasn't the only such affair."
"I abused my power as vice president to take advantage of multiple young women. I deeply regret my behavior, although I recognize that will never change what they went through."
"Evelyn, if you're watching this, I don't expect you to ever forgive me. Just know that I'm sorry."
"Mr. President, were you aware of these affairs as they were happening?"
"I had my suspicions..."
entradas.menu: "I had my suspicions..."

entradas.text: I gestured to Lucian to end the press conference.
entradas.menu: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

entradas.text: Lucian interjected.
“Neither the president nor the vice president will be taking any more questions. Thank you.”
"President Rayne, was Mr. Vectern implying that he and the covert agent posing as President Rayne's secretary were engaged in intimate relations?"
"No."
entradas.menu: "No."

entradas.text: "Yes."
entradas.menu: "Yes."

entradas.text: "Yes, and it wasn't the only such affair."
entradas.menu: "Yes, and it wasn't the only such affair."

entradas.text: "Can you elaborate, please?"
"No further questions."
"But when Mr. Vectern says he broke his marriage vows--"
"What the hell, Anton? We never discussed this."
"Sorry, Lucian made me do it."
entradas.menu: "Sorry, Lucian made me do it."

entradas.text: "What else did you think would happen?"
entradas.menu: "What else did you think would happen?"

entradas.text: "It's for the good of Sordland. You'll understand someday."
entradas.menu: "It's for the good of Sordland. You'll understand someday."

entradas.text: "Sorry. Someone has to take the fall."
entradas.menu: "Sorry. Someone has to take the fall."

entradas.text: Petr looked at me in disbelief, then shook his head.
"I guess I had this coming, the way I've been carrying on."
"I just didn't think my best friend would be the one to stick in the knife."
The reporters were becoming hard to ignore. One woman in the front row looked particularly insistent.
"Mr. Vectern!"
I nodded at Petr to take her question.
entradas.menu: Let Petr take the question.

entradas.text: "I will be answering all questions on the vice president's behalf."
entradas.menu: "I will be answering all questions on the vice president's behalf."

entradas.text: "Can you give us a comment on your resignation?"
"No, President Rayne just about covered it. I'm a terrible vice president and a worse husband. And a... a sad old drunk."
"Are you implying that you and the covert agent posing as President Rayne's secretary were engaged in intimate relations?"
"Relations, yes. Intimate? I thought so at the time."
"Yes."

"I'm not taking any questions."

entradas.text: "I will take exactly one question."

"Were you aware of those affairs while they were happening?"

“The president will not be taking any further questions. Thank you.”
The reporters reluctantly dispersed. Lucian and I looked at each other for a moment.
The reporters reluctantly dispersed. Lucian, Petr and I looked at each other for what seemed like an eternity. Finally, Petr lowered his eyes.
"Too soon."
entradas.menu: "Too soon."

entradas.text: "Mr. Vectern certainly made a scene, but it appears that you will make it out of this unscathed."
"Of course, there's now the matter of replacing both your secretary and your vice president."
"I have a few candidates in mind."
entradas.menu: "I have a few candidates in mind."

entradas.text: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."
entradas.menu: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."

entradas.text: "I guess I'll go to the palace and start packing my things, then."
"I'll come with you."
entradas.menu: "I'll come with you."

entradas.text: "Goodbye, Petr."
entradas.menu: "Goodbye, Petr."

entradas.text: I said nothing and watched Petr descend the courthouse steps to his car, alone.

Petr shook his head. I watched him descend the courthouse steps to his car, alone.
"Sir, you just had your vice president arraigned in full view of the public--"
"Very good, sir."
"Very well. We shall discuss it tomorrow."
"Very funny, sir."
We walked back up the stairs to the courthouse to watch the rest of the trial.
I watched him descend the courthouse steps to his car.

"No."

entradas.text: How could I forget? I was about to blame my best friend for a scandal that would otherwise shatter my administration. Petr hadn't said a word to me since I broke the news to him in my office.
The clamor of reporters was growing louder. Petr seemed to shrink behind the podium, his charisma failing him at last.
"That's it, then. No going back from this."
"A shame about your friend, Mr. President. But it appears you will make it out of this unscathed."
